name: Learn: ServiceAccounts
objective: CKAD › Application Environment, Configuration & Security. Create and wire ServiceAccounts: run a pod under one, disable token automount, attach an imagePullSecret, and project a bound token. Graded exactly.
description: Five strict ServiceAccount practicals. Each Check shows which requirements you met and why any failed.

questions.title: Create a ServiceAccount
questions.teach:
A **ServiceAccount** is the identity pods use to talk to the API server. Create one with `kubectl create serviceaccount <name>`; every namespace also has a `default` SA.

**Gotcha:** pods that don't set `serviceAccountName` use `default` — give real apps their own SA for least privilege.
questions.prompt:
In `sa-learn`, create a ServiceAccount named `deployer`.

Target: ServiceAccount `deployer` exists in `sa-learn`.
questions.solution:
kubectl -n sa-learn create serviceaccount deployer
kubectl -n sa-learn get sa deployer

questions.title: Run a pod under a ServiceAccount
questions.teach:
Set `spec.serviceAccountName: <sa>` on a pod to run it under that identity (RBAC then applies to that SA).

**Gotcha:** it's `serviceAccountName` on the pod spec — the deprecated `serviceAccount` field still shows but don't rely on it.
questions.prompt:
In `sa-learn`, create pod `app` (image `nginx:1.25`) that runs under ServiceAccount `deployer`.

Target: pod `app`'s `serviceAccountName` is `deployer`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: app, namespace: sa-learn }
spec:
  serviceAccountName: deployer
  containers: [ { name: web, image: nginx:1.25 } ]
YAML

verification.description: pod app runs under serviceAccountName deployer

questions.title: Disable token automount
questions.teach:
By default a pod gets the SA's token auto-mounted at `/var/run/secrets/...`. Set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` (on the pod or the SA) when the app doesn't call the API — reducing blast radius if compromised.

**Gotcha:** the pod-level setting overrides the SA-level one.
questions.prompt:
In `sa-learn`, create pod `locked` (image `nginx:1.25`) with **`automountServiceAccountToken: false`**.

Target: pod `locked` has `automountServiceAccountToken: false`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: locked, namespace: sa-learn }
spec:
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
  containers: [ { name: web, image: nginx:1.25 } ]
YAML

questions.title: Attach an imagePullSecret to the SA
questions.teach:
To pull from a private registry, create a `docker-registry` Secret and list it under the SA's `imagePullSecrets` — every pod using that SA then inherits it (no per-pod config).

**Gotcha:** `imagePullSecrets` on the **SA** applies to all its pods; on a **pod** it applies to just that pod.
questions.prompt:
In `sa-learn`, create a docker-registry Secret `regcred` (server `registry.example.com`, user `ci`, password `pass`), then add it as an **imagePullSecret** on ServiceAccount `deployer`.

Target: SA `deployer`'s `imagePullSecrets` includes `regcred`, and `regcred` is a dockerconfigjson Secret.
questions.hint: `kubectl -n sa-learn create secret docker-registry regcred --docker-server=registry.example.com --docker-username=ci --docker-password=pass`, then `kubectl -n sa-learn patch serviceaccount deployer -p '{"imagePullSecrets":[{"name":"regcred"}]}'`.
questions.solution:
kubectl -n sa-learn create secret docker-registry regcred --docker-server=registry.example.com --docker-username=ci --docker-password=pass
kubectl -n sa-learn patch serviceaccount deployer -p '{"imagePullSecrets":[{"name":"regcred"}]}'

questions.title: Project a bound token
questions.teach:
A **projected `serviceAccountToken`** volume gives a pod a short-lived, **audience-scoped** token (modern workload identity) instead of the legacy long-lived secret token. Set `audience` and `expirationSeconds`.

**Gotcha:** bound tokens auto-rotate and are scoped to an audience — far safer than a static Secret token.
questions.prompt:
In `sa-learn`, create pod `token-pod` (image `nginx:1.25`, SA `deployer`) with a **projected volume** at `/var/run/secrets/tokens` containing a `serviceAccountToken` source: audience `vault`, expirationSeconds `3600`, path `token`.

Target: `token-pod` has a projected volume whose source is a serviceAccountToken with audience `vault` and expirationSeconds `3600`.
questions.hint: `volumes: [{name: tok, projected: {sources: [{serviceAccountToken: {audience: vault, expirationSeconds: 3600, path: token}}]}}]`, mounted at /var/run/secrets/tokens.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: token-pod, namespace: sa-learn }
spec:
  serviceAccountName: deployer
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.25
    volumeMounts: [ { name: tok, mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens } ]
  volumes:
  - name: tok
    projected:
      sources:
      - serviceAccountToken: { audience: vault, expirationSeconds: 3600, path: token }
YAML

verification.description: token-pod projects a bound serviceAccountToken (audience vault, 3600s)
